This follows increased international pressure on Pakistan to act against Saeed, who is part of the JuD and FIF organizations sanctioned by the UN Security Council.

A 6.4 magnitude earthquake struck Maguindanao province in the Philippines on Sunday morning, with epicenter near Cotabato City. It caused tremors in nearby areas including Sarangani, South Cotabato, and General Santos City. Phivolcs reported no significant structural damage from this event, noting it's primarily tectonic in nature. The region experiences frequent seismic activity due to its location along the Pacific Ring of Fire.
